source_format: Named Minecraft cuboids and deterministic 128x128 RGBA8 pixel atlases; exported JSON reimported into editable Blender scenes
effort: High: site-fitting assembly design, four-view render review, targeted correction of joining and texture proportions

prop_slot_cabinet.review: Three distinct reels with square paw/cat/seven symbols, tapered ears, observer-right lever, separately raised red/mint buttons, payout tray and service back panel. Retained block enclosure fits the authored bounds.

prop_roulette_wheel.review: Eight-sided mahogany rim, gold inlay and ball rail, sixteen stylized red/black/green pockets, layered bowl and raised gold cross spinner. Pocket count and numerals are visual decoration, not casino probability data.

prop_derby_trophy.review: Grounded marble pedestal, 97 CUP plaque, supported gold running cat, pink collar, turquoise eyes, bent front/hind legs, raised tail and open laurel branches.

observed_initial_defects: Trophy coplanar cuboid surfaces produced black wedges at chest, tail and laurel branch intersections.
Trophy front leg rotation signs produced a poorly connected running pose.
Slot reel symbols and side crest were stretched by elongated face proportions; button caps were mostly buried in the console.
adopted_repairs: Staggered the depths of overlapping chest, tail and laurel pieces; verified black wedges removed in all four final views.
Reoriented front upper legs and forearms to connect to the extended paws.
Separated square symbol cards and square side badges from large panel surfaces, raised button caps, tapered ear silhouettes and mirrored the lever to the observer's right.

evidence.renderer: tools/render-models.py; Blender 5.2.1 LTS; saved scene reopened before rendering
evidence.lighting_note: Shared renderer exposure was adjusted during production. Final casino views use the same current renderer settings; initial images are diagnostic records rather than a quantitative lighting comparison.

remaining_validation: Minecraft 1.21.4 resource reload and missing-texture log inspection.
In-world yaw, scale, retained block coverage, hologram clearance and note-block interaction.
Build-all and packaged ZIP/hash verification are owned by the primary agent.
execution_notes: Blender exited 0 and saved all requested files. Profile thumbnail writes emitted a nonfatal OpenImageIO permission error; this did not prevent blend reopen or PNG render. No Java files were modified by this subtask.
